narr: Slow-moving storms fired in the late afternoon and evening hours of May 14th in a pattern of high moisture, weak overall flow, and weak vorticity advection. The slow storm movement resulted in localized heavy rainfall. One instance of flash flooding was noted in Washington County.
ev: Heavy rain caused numerous roads to flood in Downtown Beallsville. Route 40 at Maiden Street in the center of town was closed due to flooding.
lsr: NUMEROUS ROADS FLOODED IN BEALLSVILLE. ROUTE 40 AT MAIDEN STREET IS CLOSED DUE TO FLOODING.
